legal.title: Legal
legal.privacyIntro: MushroomRadar respects your privacy. This policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our services.
legal.infoBody: We collect information you provide directly (e.g. account details, preferences) and usage data (e.g. map views, feature usage) to improve our predictions and your experience.
legal.useBody: We use collected data to operate and improve MushroomRadar, personalize content, communicate with you, and comply with legal obligations. We do not sell your personal data.
legal.securityBody: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, alteration, or loss.
legal.contactBody: For privacy-related questions, contact us at privacy@mushroomradar.example.
legal.termsIntro: By using MushroomRadar you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.
legal.serviceBody: MushroomRadar provides predictive maps and information for educational and recreational purposes. Predictions are not guaranteed. Always verify species and follow local regulations before foraging.
legal.acceptableBody: You may not misuse the service, attempt to gain unauthorized access, scrape data at scale, or use it for any illegal purpose. We may suspend or terminate access for violations.
legal.disclaimerBody: MushroomRadar is provided as is. We are not liable for any decisions made based on our predictions. Foraging carries inherent risks; you are responsible for your own safety and compliance with laws.
legal.changesBody: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance. Contact: legal@mushroomradar.example.
